verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions PCI DSS, PCI scope reduction, or client-side tokenization that keeps raw card data off the developer's servers. The Web Payments SDK appears only as a page title. The 'ccof:' card-on-file sourceId and 'securely save recurring payment methods' are adjacent card-on-file features, not documentation of scope reduction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
